slides: In the last lesson we learned the basics of lines and angles. In this lesson we'll practice harder exam questions.

slides.say: We'll practice only a few questions, because lines and angles is a fairly narrow topic on the exam. There are questions only about lines and angles, but most of the time these rules are one part of a bigger geometry question. So you'll keep using them in every geometry topic.

So what makes a lines and angles question harder? Usually one of three things. A crowded figure, with several pairs of lines. Letters instead of numbers. Or a missing line that we have to add ourselves.

slides: We'll see each of them in the next questions, one at a time. [pause] Okay. I'll see you in the next video.
